fieldSourcePolicy: Only model data fields from app qvs are used for now, including included qvs data scripts such as dictionaries. The field list is app-wide and does not depend on sheets.
technicalFieldRule: Fields with English-only names, or names starting with _ or %, are treated as technical and excluded. GUID fields are not excluded automatically if the field name is user-facing.
notes: Sheet objects are not used yet for field options.
ObjectType from qlik.vw_AppSheetObjectsCurrent will be used later when it becomes informative.
Included qvs scripts from data-model flow are parsed recursively; qvs from folders 'меры' and 'измерения' are skipped.
